lead: A `tests/db/compose.yaml` comment is a claim about the image, not about the service as configured.
body: MariaDB 11.4 does not turn TLS on by itself, MySQL 8.4 generates a CA at `/var/lib/mysql/ca.pem`, and SQL Server keeps its certificate inside the instance rather than on the filesystem. Ask the running container what it serves — `docker compose exec <svc>` — before writing anything that verifies a certificate against it.
